parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

You can call the [QueryDeviceGroupList](~~93356~~) operation to query the group ID (**GroupId**).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
